abstract: We propose a novel energy-efficient AI-based bandwidth compensation technique that jointly optimizes Tx and Rx static filters. Experimental demonstration in a 800G system reveals gains of more than 1dB when compared with typical digital pre-emphasis.

articleTitle: GCN-Assisted SnF Scheduling Method for Inter-Datacenter Bulk Transfers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A GCN-assisted scheduling method is presented to schedule bulk transfers across the inter-DCN in a store-and-forward manner. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed method obtains better network performance and lower complexity than the conventional methods.

articleTitle: A novel distributed spun fiber twist sensor based on frequency-scanning φ-OTDR
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel distributed twist sensor utilizing frequency-scanning φ-OTDR in a spun fiber is theoretically analyzed and experimentally demonstrated by tracking the fiber twist induced frequency shift of correlation peak, enabling distributed quantitative twist measurement.

articleTitle: In0.52Al0.48As Based Single Photon Avalanche Diodes with Multiple M-Layers for High-Efficiency and Fast Temporal Responses
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multiple multiplication-layers SPADs with excellent performances in terms of high-efficiency (>74%), neat impulse response time (101ps), and short hold-off time (83ns@<1% afterpulsing) can be achieved simultaneously with a simple passive quenching circuit under gated-mode operations.

articleTitle: A method to compute the local birefringence vector in twisted and bent antiresonant hollow-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work proposes a technique to elucidate mode coupling when antiresonant fibers are twisted and bent. From this, we show how the birefringence of a nested antiresonant nodeless fiber changes as function of the deployment.

articleTitle: Quasi-Constant Signal Power Transmission with Low Signal RIN by DRA with Incoherent-Forward and Coherent-Backward Pumps
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We measure characteristics of a transmitted WDM signal in an 80 km-long SMF under bi-directionally pumped DRA with incoherent-forward and coherent-backward pumps. The signal shows OSNR of 50.0 dB and RIN less than -140 dB/Hz.

articleTitle: Towards Optimized Demand Routing in QKD Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate buffer-aware demand-routing of key-consumption demands in QKD networks and implement a measurement-based framework for path selection. The proposed ML-based algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics by 22 % and 92 % for networks under test.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Wireless Transmission of QPSK Signals at 2 THz
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Wireless transmission of QPSK signals at 2 THz has been demonstrated using modulator-based optical combs for the transmitter and hot electron bolometer mixers combined with phase-locked terahertz quantum cascade lasers for the receiver.

articleTitle: Optical Beam Steering using Mode-Coupling Control in Plastic Optical Fibre
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An all-fibre beam steering solution, based on mode coupling in 240-μm core size POF, is presented. Using DMT modulation over 90-cm wireless link and steering full angle of 9°, a throughput of 1.6 Gbps is achieved for visible light.

articleTitle: Integrated source of telecom-band photon-pairs based on high index silica glass spiral waveguides
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We generate correlated photon-pairs via spontaneous four-wave mixing in high index silica glass spiral waveguides. Results show that spontaneous Raman scattering is the main noise origin, and propagation loss limits the optimum length of waveguides.

articleTitle: Field Trial of High-Resolution Distributed Fiber Sensing over Multicore Fiber in Metropolitan Area with Construction Work Detection using Advanced MIMO-DAS
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a successful field trial of MIMO-DAS over multicore fiber (MCF) allowing for accurate localization of acoustic events in the city of L’Aquila, Italy. We show a 2m spatial resolution and 1mHz-380Hz acoustic bandwidth.

articleTitle: 100G FSO Transmission Using 3-Bit DAC and Self-Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a virtual-carrier-assisted self-coherent system aided by a digital resolution enhancement technique, we experimentally demonstrate 100 Gbps FSO transmission over an outdoor 42 m link, supported by a single photoreceiver and a simplified transmitter with a 3-bit DAC.

articleTitle: Next Generation Wireless Fronthaul using VCSEL-based Free Space Optics
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A free-space optics (FSO) based fronthaul final drop is proposed, enabling cost-effective remote unit deployment. Experimental results show >45dB RF dynamic range and an EVM of 1.1% for a 2x20MHz 64QAM RF signal.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction Based on P-ConvLSTM in Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on Prophet-guided neural network, P-ConvLSTM is proposed for traffic prediction. Proved by multi-group real traffic data in OTN, P-ConvLSTM has high accuracy and strong generalization.

articleTitle: High-Performance EO Polymer/Si and InP Nano-Hybrid Optical Modulators in O-band and C-band Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present high-efficiency of 0.18Vcm and 252Gbps of PAM-4 high-speed operation for EO polymer/Si and InP hybrid optical modulators in C-band wavelengths. We also demonstrate record high-efficiency of 0.35Vcm and high-speed operation in O-band wavelengths.

articleTitle: Second-Order Temporal Interference with Thermal Light: Interference beyond the Coherence Time
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report observation of a counter-intuitive phenomenon in multi-path correlation interferometry with thermal light. The intensity correlation between the outputs of two unbalanced Mach-Zehnder interferometers (UMZI) with two classically correlated beams of thermal light at the input exhibits genuine second-order interference with the visibility of 1/3. Surprisingly, the second-order interference does not degrade at all no matter how much the path length difference in each UMZI is increased beyond the coherence length of the thermal light. Moreover, the second-order interference is dependent on the difference of the UMZI phases. These results differ substantially from those of the entangled-photon Franson interferometer which exhibits two-photon interference dependent on the sum of the UMZI phases and the interference vanishes as the path length difference in each UMZI exceeds the coherence length of the pump laser. Our work offers deeper insight into the interplay between interference and coherence in multi-photon interferometry.

articleTitle: Adaptive Geometric Constellation Shaping in a Transmission System with a Real-time Optimisation Loop
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the real-time performance of an adaptive intelligent transceiver, tailoring the constellation shape to the transmission system by iteratively maximising the information throughput, quantified by the GMI.

articleTitle: Mid-Span Pump Phase Shift Applied to WDM Wavelength Conversion for the Suppression of FWM Crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We apply mid-span pump-phase shifting to the wavelength conversion of a 9 channel WDM band in order to suppress inter-channel nonlinear crosstalk. SNR improvements between 3-6dB are observed through the use of the technique

articleTitle: London Quantum-Secured Metro Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a London Quantum-Secured Metro Network using Quantum Key Distribution between three London nodes together with customer access tails. The commercially-ready solution is fully integrated into the BT network and on-boarded its first customer.

articleTitle: Distributed Characterization of Low-loss Hollow Core Fibers using EDFA-assisted Low-cost OTDR instrument
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We use a low-cost commercially-available Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR). Sensitivity is boosted by 28 dB using two EDFAs, enabling characterization with spatial resolution of 1.5 m, which is 10 times better than previously reported. © 2023 The Authors

articleTitle: Bandwidth-Dependent Gain Deviation in E+S band Bismuth Doped Fiber Amplifier under Automatic Gain Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Although bismuth doped fiber amplifier could provide ultra-wideband gain, the gain inhomogeneity might ultimately restrict its applicable bandwidth. This work explores this limitation through experimental measurements of signal dependent gain deformation.

articleTitle: Passive Integrated Athermal (De)Multiplexers on 300 mm Silicon Photonics Wafers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate passive integrated athermal (de)multiplexers showing near 0 pm/°C wavelength shift from 20 to 80 °C on 300 mm silicon photonics wafers. Wafer-scale data shows its high fabrication tolerance for next-generation optical transceiver systems.

articleTitle: 110.4 Tbit/s Same-wavelength Bidirectional Optical Fiber Transmission over 100 km G. 654D Fiber in Super-C band with Rayleigh Scattering Noise Suppressed by Raman Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: we have demonstrated a capacity of 111.6 Tbit/s over a 75-km G.654D fiber along with a capacity of 110.4 Tbit/s over 100 km in super C-band based on the same-wavelength bidirectional optical fiber transmission scheme.

articleTitle: PROPH: A Contention-free and Elastic Bandwidth Scheduling Scheme for AWGR-based Optical DCN
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A contention-free scheduling scheme PROPH is proposed for AWGR-based optical DCN to elastically allocate adaptable bandwidth. Assessments validate that the network deploying PROPH decreases 73.6% packet loss and 11.9% server-to-server latency, improves 11.6% network throughput.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of All-Optical 8-Gbit/s Secure Free-Space Chaotic Communications over 8.2-meter Link Based on Unidirectional Injection-Locking Chaos Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first experimentally demonstrate an 8-Gbit/s free-space secure chaotic optical communications link over 8.2 meters in a long corridor with satisfactory BER performance by achieving one-way injection locking chaos synchronization.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Neural Network Assisted Machine Learning EDFA Gain Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An enhanced EDFA model employing auxiliary neural networks is proposed. Adaptive to different devices, the model reduces the root mean square error from 0.04 to 0.02 dB with significantly less amount of training data.

articleTitle: Real-time Software Implementation of Coherent Receiver DSP Adopting Multiplication-Based Parallel Frequency Offset Compensation for Fully Virtualized Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes multiplication-based parallel frequency offset compensation (FOC) for virtualized access networks and demonstrates real-time softwarization of the full DSP function suite, including polarization demultiplexing, FOC, carrier phase recovery, and decoding, on a server.

articleTitle: Controllable Passive Multi-polarization-states Generator based on Silicon Photonics for Quantum Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon-based controllable multi-polarization-states generator for quantum key distribution. Our device can effectively generate various sets of well-defined four-polarization states using the thermo-optics effect and combine them into one port at a telecom-wavelength.

articleTitle: Transparent Relay and Switching of THz-wave Signals in 285-GHz Band Using Photonic Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel system for transparent relaying and switching of terahertz (THz)-wave signals is demonstrated using a low-loss optical modulator and ultra-fast tunable laser. A 32-Gb/s OFDM signal was transmitted over a switchable fiber–THz–fiber–THz system in the 285-GHz band.

articleTitle: Real-time 33.6 Tb/s (42 × 800 Gb/s) Unrepeatered Transmission over 302 km Using ROPA System
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a record unrepeatered transmission with the capacity of 33.6 Tb/s (42 × 800 Gb/s) over 302.7 km (47.52 dB) with a single fiber configuration, using forward Raman pump, backward ROPA, and ultra-low loss & large effective area fiber.

articleTitle: Duobinary-Coded Coherent ΣΔ Radio-over-Fiber Transmission at 9 GHz Downlink Channel Spacing
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show digitized radio-over-fiber transmission using coherent envelope detection. A low EVM of 1.3%, a high optical budget of 34.6dB and 25% improvement in spectral occupancy are found when introducing duobinary signaling and coherent detection.

articleTitle: 190 GHz Bandwidth Modified Uni-Traveling Carrier Photodiodes with High Saturation Power
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Back-illuminated modified uni-traveling carrier photodiodes with improved saturation performance at ultra-high frequencies are developed. The 4-μm-diameter PD exhibits a 3-dB bandwidth of 190 GHz with a saturation power of −1.21 dBm@190 GHz.

articleTitle: Explainable Machine Learning-enabled Just-enough Margin Configurations in Dynamic S+C+L-band Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We configure an explainable machine learning-enabled just-enough margin for each lightpath in dynamic S+C+L-band optical networks. Explainable decisions improve blocking ratio and spectral efficiency performances by 35.9% and 17.2% compared with the benchmarks.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Temperature and Acoustic Sensing with Coherent Correlation OTDR
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Superimposed temperature variations and dynamic strain applied through a 400 Hz acoustic signal on a 195 m single-mode fiber section are successfully measured using a coherent correlation optical time domain reflectometry as an interrogator.

articleTitle: Slim Push-Pull Fiber Array Connector for Optical Chips
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report connector loss of 0.42 dB for a low-profile fiber-to-chip connector to replace fiber pigtails and enable flip-chip electronic assembly of optical chips for co-packaged optics.

articleTitle: Distributed Polarization and Coupling Analysis of a 3-Coupled-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: OFDR-based, distributed characterization of polarization and coupling properties of a 3-coupled-core fiber is reported. Results highlight the beating among the supermodes of the fiber, enabling the evaluation of their polarization and modal birefringence.

articleTitle: High Power Uncooled CW-DFB lasers with High Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate L-band and O-band CW-DFB lasers with kink-free and stable single mode lasing over 600 mW at 55ºC and 200 mW at 85℃, respectively. More than 2000 hours reliable operation at 90ºC is achieved.

articleTitle: Real-Time 400 Gbit/s PAM-4 Optical Link over 30 km for Future Access Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 4λ WDM real-time 100 Gbit/s/λ PAM-4 fiber link supporting 30 km of fiber propagation and 23.5 dB supported channel insertion losses using analog pre-equalization and common semiconductor based optical pre-amplification.

articleTitle: Zero-Offset Frequency Locking of Lasers at Ultra-Low Optical Powers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel digital dither-OPLL for homodyne optical carrier locking below -80 dBm optical power. The locking performance is characterized and verified with pump recovery in a phase-sensitive parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Complexity Versus Accuracy Tradeoffs in Nonlinear Fiber Propagation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Some of the most widespread analytical models for nonlinear propagation in fiber optic coherent systems are reviewed, highlighting the tradeoffs between accuracy and complexity in different transmission scenarios, including wide-band optical systems and short-reach links.

articleTitle: Long-Haul Unidirectional Transmission over Weakly-Coupled MCF with Distance-Insensitive Inter-Core Skew Spread
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate unidirectional 3000-km transmission over homogeneous step-index weakly-coupled multi-core fiber. Distance-insensitive pulse broadening is obtained by inline core-permutation without any fan-in/fan-out device, enabling inter-core-crosstalk cancellation at 3000 km only with 3-ns-processing window in MIMO-DSP.

articleTitle: Optical Beam Steerable and Flexible Data Rate Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (OFDM-NOMA) Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate visible-light-communication (VLC) system using spatial-light-modulator (SLM) and orthogonal-frequency-division-multiplexing non-orthogonal-multiple access (OFDM-NOMA), illustrating the flexibilities of optical-beam steering and data-rate allocation for multiple users.

articleTitle: 56 GBaud PAM-4 Direct Detection with High-Speed Avalanche Photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 56 GBaud PAM-4 transmission by using a high-speed waveguide avalanche photodiode (WG APD) and an electro absorption modulated laser (EML). Compared to a PIN photodiode, the WG APD reduces the power budget in a B2B setup by 6 dB.

articleTitle: A 200Gb/s QAM-16 Silicon Photonic Transmitter with 4 Binary-Driven EAMs in An MZI Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A DAC-less 200Gb/s QAM-16 transmitter in a multi-micron silicon-photonics platform using 4 binary-driven SiGe EAMs in an unbalanced MZI is presented. The transmitter exhibits bit-error rates of 3×10<sup>-4</sup> and 2.8×10<sup>-4</sup> for square and hexagonal constellations.

articleTitle: Simultaneous communications and vibration sensing over a single 100-km deployed fiber link by fiber interferometry
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous 60 GBaud 16-QAM transmissions and vibration sensing over a single 100-km deployed fiber link. Vibration localization is realized by extracting the phases of a co-propagating pilot and a counter-propagating tone.

articleTitle: Is Intelligence the Answer to Deal with the 5 V’s of Telemetry Data?
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Telemetry data and big data share volume, velocity, variety, veracity and value characteristics. We propose a distributed telemetry architecture and show how intelligence can help dealing with the 5 V’s of optical networks telemetry data.

articleTitle: Wide-Bandwidth, Enhanced-Quality Wireless Signal Detection with Low-Bandwidth Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss a new method for detecting high-bandwidth wireless signals with low-bandwidth electronics. We experimentally demonstrate the detection of 24 GBd-QPSK Nyquist data with 4 GHz electronics and a Q-factor enhancement of 2.2 dB.

articleTitle: Aging effects on the attenuation coefficient and splice losses in installed submarine optical cables
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Aging effects in submarine optical cables were evaluated with OTDR measurements along 12 years. Penalties from splice losses were twofold higher than those from fiber attenuation. Cables are expected to last more than 25 years.

articleTitle: Transparent Radio–Fiber–Radio–Fiber System in 100-GHz Band for Indoor Uplink Signal Transmission in Beyond 5G
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first radio–fiber–radio–fiber system for transparent delivery of 100-GHz radio signals from indoor to a central station. We successfully transmitted 16-QAM single-carrier and OFDM signals with line rates of approximately 30 and 40 Gb/s over the system consisting of two cascaded wireless–RoF links in the 100-GHz band.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Composable-ML-assisted Autonomous Lightpath Configuration over a Field-deployed SDM Network with 7-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the first field trial of autonomous lightpath configuration over an SDM network using 7-core fibers. With a composable-ML-based configuration algorithm, ~10-second lightpath provisioning and automated failover are achieved while desirable QoT is secured. © 2023 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Power Performance of Type-II GaInAsSb/InP Uniform Absorber Uni-Traveling Carrier Photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first power performance of Type-II GaInAsSb/InP UTC-PDs. The UTCPDs attain a zero-bias output power of -14 dBm at 100 GHz, one of the highest reported for any zero-bias photodiodes.

articleTitle: InP-based CV-QKD PIC Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An InP-based photonic integrated circuit (PIC) transmitter for pulsed Gaussian-modulated coherent-state (GMCS) CV-QKD protocol is presented and characterized. Results show potential asymptotic secret key rates of 0.4 Mbps at 11 km, and up to 2.3 Mbps in back-to-back configuration.

articleTitle: Frequency averaging with rotation angle tracking technique in phase-OTDR DAS for large-scale vibration measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Sensitivity degradation specific to frequency-multiplexed phase OTDR in measuring large strain change is clarified for the first time. We demonstrate one solution based on frequency averaging with rotation angle tracking technique to measure sub-με vibrations.

articleTitle: 25G+ Distance-Adaptive Visible Light Communications Enabled by Entropy Loading
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using probabilistic shaping together with multi-carrier modulation and entropy loading, we experimentally demonstrate a distance-adaptive RGB-VLC system operating with diffuse white light and supporting record-high bit rates of 26–46Gbit/s over 50-200cm.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Erbium-Doped Waveguide Amplifier Enabled Multi-Tb/s (16×1.6T) Coherent Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first EDWA-enabled Terabit-class coherent optical communication with 1.6-Tb/s net bit rate per channel and 16-channel WDM transmission over 81-km fiber, proving the potential of such on-chip amplification for future coherent applications.

articleTitle: First Monolithically-Integrated Silicon CMOS Coherent Optical Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An O-band coherent optical receiver (CORX) is integrated in a 45-nm monolithic CMOS SOI process. The CORX operates to 80 Gbps with FEC-acceptable BER at 1.2 pJ/bit energy efficiency. To our knowledge, this is the first monolithically-integrated Silicon CMOS CORX.

articleTitle: Partial MIMO-based Mode Division Multiplexing Transmission over the First Field-Deployed 15-Mode Fiber in Metro Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We assess mode division multiplexing transmission based on partial MIMO equalization over 6.1 km of the first deployed 15-mode fiber in L’Aquila, Italy. We demonstrate more than 13Tb/s throughput with reduced receiver DSP resources.

articleTitle: 10-km Transmission of 106-Gb/s PAM4 with Directly Modulated DFB Lasers in the CWDM Range
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The 106-Gb/s PAM4 operation of four DMLs in the 1.3-μm CWDM range demonstrated < 2.0 dB TDECQ after 5-km transmission. Clear eye openings and BER below KP4-FEC limit (2.2 × 10<sup>−4</sup>) were achieved even after 10-km transmission.

articleTitle: Optical Switching will Innovate Intra Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial will discuss how optical switching technologies can innovate future data center networks. The two core technologies, large-port-count optical switches that have pay-as-you-grow scalability, and simple and fast optical switch network control are reviewed.

articleTitle: Millimeter-level Resolution Photonic Multiband Radar Using a Single MZM and Sub-GHz-Bandwidth Electronics
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We here propose a novel cost-effective millimeter-level resolution photonic multiband radar system using a single MZM driven by a 1-GHz-bandwidth LFM signal. It experimentally shows an ~8.5-mm range resolution through coherence-processing-free multiband data fusion.

articleTitle: Photonic-Lantern-Based MDM Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Results for air clad photonic lanterns are presented including new results for a 6-mode photonic lantern. Results for cross talk dynamics in a 1.6 km link versus both time and wavelengths are presented.

articleTitle: Highly Optimized O-band Si Ring Modulators for Low-Power Hybrid CMOS-SiPho Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present O-band Si ring modulators with up to 58pm/V electro-optic and 610pm/mW thermo-optic modulation efficiencies and >24GHz modulation bandwidth, enabling a hybrid CMOS-SiPho transceiver with error-free operation at 40Gbps NRZ with <4pJ/bit link energy.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Optoelectronic-Phased-Array Driven THz-wave Power Combination and Beam Steering
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed a THz-wave power-combination and beam-steering system driven by an optoelectronic phased array. The 300-GHz waves from an antenna-coupled InP/InGaAs UTC-PD array are combined with 16-dB gain and steered continuously over a 30° range.

articleTitle: Delay Compensated Quad-level Delta-sigma Modulation Dual-color DRoF System for Beyond 5G Mobile Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a high-performance dual-color B5G DRoF system using delay compensation. A quad-level 6-Gbit/s 64-QAM OFDM signal was successfully transmitted over the proposed system, showing a much better performance compared to the conventional 1-bit system.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Carrier Phase Recovery Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the most recent advances in carrier phase estimation algorithms for coherent optical communications, with special emphasis on multi-carrier modulation systems and on the interplay between linear and nonlinear phase noise sources.

articleTitle: 100 Gbps/λ Transmission with Quantum Dot O-Band Comb Source using 50 GBd PAM4/16QAM-OFDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a record high transmission rate of 100 Gbps/λ with 50 GBd PAM4 and 16QAM-OFDM signals using a packaged wavelength-tunable InAs/InGaAs quantum dot-based laser comb source for short-reach application. We successfully show the performance is within the standard FEC limits.

articleTitle: Statistical Properties of NLIN in Presence of PDL
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an analytical model which predicts the statistical properties of nonlinear interference noise in fiber links affected by PDL. We show that many features of NLIN, such as its phase and polarization rotation noise may be significantly modified by PDL components present in the link.

articleTitle: Direct Intensity Detection of Complex Communication Data Signals Using a Real-time Photonics Spectrogram
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We use a time-lens spectrogram for real-time recovery of complex modulation data signals using a single photodiode, no local oscillator, and simple decision method. Our proof-of-concept experiment decodes QAM4 and QAM8 under the FEC limit.

articleTitle: Electro-optical phase-locked loop for hybrid integrated external cavity laser
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement an analog EO-PLL for a III/V-Si<inf>3</inf>N<inf>4</inf> hybrid integrated ECL to generate a highly-linear FMCW signal over multiple wavelengths. The ranging resolution is improved from 5 m to 35 cm for a 100-m target.

articleTitle: Colorless and Directionless ROADM for Meshed Coupled-Core Multicore Fiber Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first meshed spatial-super-channel switching SDM network using field-deployed coupled-core multicore fibers with a 3 line-side, colorless, directionless ROADM. We evaluate 19 network scenarios including add&drop, bypass and grooming with 2 Tb/s granularity.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a 96 Channel WDM-FSO System Based Mobile Fronthaul with 1024QAM Delta-Sigma-Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, we experimentally demonstrate a 96-Channel WDM-FSO mobile fronthaul system, which can support 7.68Tbit/s PDM-OFDM-1024QAM signals delivery over 2-km SMF and 104m FSO link with the aid of 1-bit delta-sigma modulation.

articleTitle: Multi-User Entanglement Routing for Quantum Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multipath routing for sharing entanglement between multiple devices was simulated on real network topologies and compared against single-path routing. Results show improved entanglement rates, especially for topologies with a higher average nodal degree. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: QoT Estimation Improvement with Inputs Refinement Tool for C+L Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a technique to estimate lumped losses thus OSNR, nonlinear SNR, GSNR, and SNR in C+L optical networks. We show with simulations that SNR estimation accuracy is within 0.5dB and that the technique is robust to uncertainty due to aging.

articleTitle: SINET6: Nationwide 400GE-Based Academic Backbone Network in Japan
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper describes the practical network design of a newly-launched nationwide 400GE-based academic backbone network called SINET6. Its fully-meshed architecture with multi-layer network coordination, network services with on-demand capabilities, and performance evaluations are reported.

articleTitle: A Direct Bond Interconnect 3D Co-Integrated Silicon-Photonic Transceiver in 12nm FinFET with -20.3dBm OMA Sensitivity and 691fJ/bit
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of an electronic-photonic co-designed transceiver circuit heterogeneously 3D co-integrated with high-density, low-parasitic Direct Bond Interconnect (DBI<sup>®</sup>) featuring full SerDes that achieves -20.3dBm OMA sensitivity and 691fJ/bit link energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Optical Network Diagnostics Using Graph Neural Networks and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an AI-powered network diagnostic strategy including alarm clustering and fault localization with >98% accuracy for up-to 16-degree ROADMs and demonstrate the advantages of using NLP in encoding.

articleTitle: 4.8 Tb/s PS-PAM-8 Bidirectional Transmission over 10-km 24-core Fiber Using Linear Equalization at O-Band
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 4.8-Tb/s PS-PAM-8 bidirectional transmission is experimentally demonstrated over 10km 24-core fiber with SOA using only linear equalization at O-band. The experimental results indicate that the MCFs are well-suited for optical short-reach systems employing IM/DD.

articleTitle: Surface and Underwater Surveillance based on Highly Sensitive Distributed Fiber-optic Hydrophone
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report field test results of surface and underwater surveillance based on fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) and highly sensitive distributed fiber-optic hydrophone (DFOH). Various intrusive targets like boat, frogman and etc. are detected.

articleTitle: CV-QKD Receiver Platform Based On A Silicon Photonic Integrated Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the characterization of a SiGe PIC-based receiver along with its usage in a Gaussian-modulated coherent state CV-QKD setup. Excess noise measurements lead to secret key rate estimations of 280 kbit/s at 6.9 km.

articleTitle: Polarization-Encoded BB84 QKD Transmitter Sourced by a SiGe Light Emitter
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-encoded BB84 transmitter sourced by a SiGe light source and show that such a potentially "all-silicon" QKD scheme can operate well below the QBER threshold at which secret keys can be established.

articleTitle: Polarization Insensitive Photonic Integrated 1x4 WDM Wavelength Selective Switch for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 1x4 WDM polarization-insensitive wavelength selective switch based on bulk SOAs co-integrated with AWGs. Results show a net gain, broadband, and error-free operation with 0.6 dB power penalty up to 25Gbps NRZ-OOK.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity Free Operation of SOA for Use in High-Capacity Co-Packaged Optics
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel concept to generate high-capacity WDM signals from single source of non-mode-locked multi-wavelength light using SOAs. Using micro-ring modulators in a way to suppress SOA nonlinearity, high-quality PAM4 signals can be generated.

articleTitle: End-to-end Orchestration in Support of IIoT Applications over Optically Interconnected TSN Domains
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that joint orchestration of TSN and optical network domains in support of IIoT applications reduces the TSN blocking by four orders of magnitude and the usage of high priority queues by a 28-100%.

articleTitle: 128GBd record QPSK transmission over 20 631 km and PCS16QAM transmission over 12 558 km using InP technology Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the generation, transmission, and detection of 128GBd QPSK and PCS16QAM signals in optical submarine systems. We have validated the transmission of 33 channels PCS16QAM along the C-band over 12 558 km with an average of 0.74 dB margin from 25% soft FEC threshold.

articleTitle: 106.25 Gbaud 4-Level Pulse Amplitude Modulation Links Supporting (2x)100Gigabit Ethernet on Single Lambda
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and compare EML- and DML-based optical interconnects with 106.25 Gbaud NRZ-OOK and PAM4 for computing applications. The results show that both transmitters can be used to enable optical-amplification-free transmissions with low-complexity DSP.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Optical Telemetry Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A distributed telemetry system is proposed with agents receiving and analyzing data before sending to a centralized manager. Intelligent data aggregation on optical constellations telemetry largely reduces data rate without introducing significant error.

articleTitle: Optical Network Tomography: Demonstration of Anomaly Loss Monitoring and Fiber-Type Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate optical network tomography software prototype for localization of anomaly loss and fiber-type identification based on the estimated optical power profile using experimentally measured waveform data in a multi-span transmission testbed.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of MPI noise mitigation effects for various modulation schemes in analog IFoF-based mobile fronthaul link
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Effects of multipath interference (MPI) mitigation for different modulation schemes in analog IFoF link is experimentally evaluated. The results show phase-dithered and polarization- scrambled IFoF signal could tolerate 30-dB MPI for two types of external modulations.

articleTitle: Power dissipation bounds for photonic analog to digital converters
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first power dissipation bounds for a generalised class of photonic analog to digital converters, and estimate their achievable power efficiency compared to conventional electronic designs.

articleTitle: CompQoTE: Generalizing QoT Estimation with Composable ML and End-to-End Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes CompQoTE, a composable QoT estimation design with end-to-end learning capability. Results show CompQoT can generalize arbitrary lightpaths while achieving > 90% estimation accuracy for unseen lightpaths.

articleTitle: Integrated Microlens Coupler for Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and experimentally demonstrate a new silicon photonic fiber coupling method using integrated microlens couplers. Efficient and broadband coupling to a single mode fiber with a best coupling loss of 0.9 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: 8-Channel CWDM TOSA for CPO External Laser Sources Employing a Blind Mate Optical Connector
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an 8-channel CWDM TOSA designed for CPO ELS modules adopted with a blind mate optical connector. The mechanical size of the TOSA is as small as 22.5 mm × 13.0 mm × 4.0 mm to be built in a standard QSFP housing. The pigtailed PMF cables are 180-degree turned to draw back to the card edge. The length of pigtailed PMF cables is as short as 95 mm. The fiber- coupled power is >20 dBm over the case temperature range of 25 °C to 55 °C. The polarization orientation of PMFs attached to a standard 12-lane MT ferrule is set to the horizontal slow axis and the measured PER is >20 dB for all channels.

articleTitle: Edge-carrier-assisted Phase-Retrieval Based on Deep Learning Enabling low CSPR and low Applied Dispersion Values
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We explore the use of deep learning to loosen the constraints and enhance the performance of weak-carrier-assisted phase-retrieval receivers. The applied-dispersion-value can be reduced by 4-times and the complexity by 50% with low sensitivity penalties.

articleTitle: Silicon-Based On-Chip Phase-Coded Linearly-Chirped Microwave Waveform Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and design a silicon photonic chip for phase-coded linearly-chirped microwave waveform generation based on opto-electronic oscillator. Using the chip, a phase-coded linearly-chirped microwave waveform with an ultra-large time-bandwidth product of 1.96×10<sup>6</sup> is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Micro-LEDs and Quantum based-Full Color Devices for Display and Visible Light Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Red-green-blue (RGB) full-color micro light-emitting diodes (μ-LEDs) fabricated from semipolar (20-21) wafers, with a quantum-dot photoresist color-conversion layer, were demonstrated. We also demonstrated high-stability quantum dot-converted 3-in-1 full-color minilight-emitting diodes passivated with low-temperature atomic layer deposition. A hybrid QD-NR-μLED with an ALD passivation layer and efficient NRET has been fabricated to produce a monolithic RGB μLED device with QDs printed by super-inkjet (SIJ) printing system. We also presented a high-efficiency InGaN red micro-LED fabricated by the incorporation of superlattice structure, atomic layer deposition passivation, and a distributed Bragg reflector. Finally, a high 3-dB bandwidth semipolar (20–21) long-wavelength InGaN/GaN μLED has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Performance Verification of 7,424 × 7,424 Optical Switch Offering 1.4 μs Switching Time
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally verify performance of 7,424×7,424 optical switches that offer 1.4-μs switching time. Two key enablers are reported; newly developed polarization-insensitive 64×1 silicon-photonic switches integrated with wavelength-tunable filters, and a fast burst-mode coherent receiver.

articleTitle: MAESTRO: MAke-bEfore-break StraTegy for Reconfiguration in Optical Datacenters
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a MAke-bEfore-break StraTegy for Reconfiguration in Optical datacenters (MAESTRO). The simulation results show a reduction in packet loss by up to 98% compared to a baseline reconfiguration method.

articleTitle: Demonstration of PDM-2048QAM W-Band Signal Delivery over 4.6 km Wireless transmission Employing One bit DSM
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In a photonics-aided mm-wave communication system, we successfully achieved W-band long-distance transmission of PDM-1024QAM/2048QAM signals over 4.6 km by using a PTFE lenses and Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM).

articleTitle: C- and L-band low polarization sensitive nanosecond 1×2 electro-optic MZI switch on 3-μm thick silicon platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We fabricated and assessed a wideband (C-/L- band) nanosecond 1×2 electro-optic switch in 3-μm thick silicon. Results show 2.5dB lowest insertion loss, 16dB averaged extinction ration, 2.5dB polarization dependent loss and 6-ns switching time.

articleTitle: Developments of VCSEL-based transceivers for Co-Packaging
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper covers recent industry developments in VCSEL-based transceivers that are designed for co-packaging on a first level package with ASICs, such as CPUs, GPUs, and data center switches.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of Sequence Selection for Nonlinear Probabilistic Shaping
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose two novel techniques to implement sequence selection (SS) for fiber nonlinearity mitigation, demonstrating a nonlinear shaping gain of 0.24 bits/s/Hz, just 0.1bits/s/Hz below the SS capacity lower bound.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a High-Power and High-Reflection-Tolerance Semiconductor Laser for Co-Packaged Optics
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-power (>100mW) semiconductor laser is demonstrated with a small far-field divergence of 9.3°×17.6°. Under a −19.8dB back-reflection, this laser exhibits little changes in relative intensity noise and almost no power penalty for 53Gbd/s PAM4 transmission.

articleTitle: Solving the Escape Density Problem: Making connections count with SCIP
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon Photonics Chiplets in Package (SCIP) creates a paradigm shift, enabling escape densities in optics that match the core silicon and creating a scalable platform that meets requirements of future data center and compute architectures.

articleTitle: Free-Space Visible Light Communication with Downstream and Upstream Transmissions Supporting Multiple Moveable Receivers Using Light-Diffusing Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a free-space bi-directional visible-light-communication (VLC) system using a light-diffusion-fiber (LDF) optical antenna. It allows 360° field-of-view (FOV) noncontact and moveable VLC detection, achieving 210-Mbit/s downlink and 850-Mbit/s uplink transmissions.

articleTitle: Improved QoT Estimations through Refined Signal Power Measurements in a Disaggregated and Partially-loaded Live Production Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed to combine signal power measurements from optical amplifiers and channel monitors in a disaggregated and partially-loaded live production network to reduce the standard deviation of GSNR estimation error from 0.6347dB to 0.4387dB.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Simplified SOA Nonlinearity Mitigation scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a digital learned-filter mitigation scheme for semiconductor optical amplifier-induced nonlinear distortion of single-polarisation 32 GBd 16QAM and 64QAM signals in a back-to-back configuration.

articleTitle: Low-noise, Flat-spectrum, Polarization-Maintaining All-Fiber Frequency Comb for Wideband Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and optimize a parametric frequency comb generator using all polarization-maintaining components, highly-doped PM fiber and PM highly-nonlinear fibers, obtaining 500 tones over 100nm with >-5dBm per tone and less than 40kHz linewidth.

articleTitle: 8.1 Gbps PAM8 Long-Wave IR FSO Transmission using a 9.15-µm Directly-Modulated QCL with an MCT Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a Long-Wave IR FSO link with a 9.15-µm directly modulated quantum cascade laser at room temperature. Up to 8.1 Gb/s PAM8 transmission over 1.4 meter is achieved with a wideband MCT detector. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Automatic Tuning of Vernier Microring Filters Using Comprehensive Characterization Models and Hybrid Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An efficient approach to automatically configure and tune Vernier microring filters by utilizing hybrid optimization algorithms and robust characterization models is presented. Automatic tuning of a four-ring Vernier filter over the entire C-band is experimentally demonstrated to evaluate this method.

articleTitle: Record Gain of 18-dB for Broadband Single-Model Cr-Doped Crystalline Core Fiber by Small Core Diameter
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate record gain of 18-dB broadband single-mode Cr-doped crystalline core fiber employing small core diameter. The gain-per-unit-length is 90 dB/m, which is higher than currently achieved Er and Bi-doped fibers of 0.6 - 3 dB/m.

articleTitle: A high-power, power-efficient 1.3-μm SOA-integrated DFB laser for CPO applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a high power 1.3-μm SOA-integrated DFB laser which exhibits a power conversion efficiency of more than 25% with output power of 350 mW up to 45°C. This device also shows an averaged RIN of below -155 dB/Hz.

articleTitle: Impact of Laser Phase Noise on Ranging Precision Within and Beyond Laser Coherence Length in FMCW LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the impact of laser phase noise on ranging precision in a frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) LiDAR system, demonstrating ranging of 384.72 m with ∼15 cm precision at 7× intrinsic laser coherence length.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Point-to-Multipoint 100G Coherent PON to Support Broadband Access and B5G/6G Mobile X-haul
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a rate-flexible point-to-multipoint 100G coherent PON with downlink and uplink using digital subcarrier multiplexing to simultaneously support up to 64 nodes for fixed broadband and W-band mmWave wireless access.

articleTitle: Optical Frequency Transfer Stability of 1E-15 at 1 Second Over Correlated Core Pairs in a 40 km 7-core Fiber Link
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 40km stabilized optical frequency transfer system with fractional frequency stability of 1e-15 at 1s without single-core bidirectional propagation. Highly correlated cores of a 7-core fiber are used for signal transmission and return, mitigating uncorrelated phase fluctuations found in duplex approaches.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics for High-Speed 5G and Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical fronthaul for radio access networks will enable the promise of 5G and beyond. We describe how centralized sources and diminutive microring modulators can meet these goals while also reducing footprint and power consumption. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Modal Gain Equalization of Few-mode Erbium-doped Fiber Amplifiers Enabled by Mirrored Mode Exchanges
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a six-mode erbium-doped fiber amplifier with significantly reduced differential modal gain (DMG) by mirrored exchanging of the spatial modes for the first time. A DMG of <1.8 dB across the whole C-band is experimentally achieved.

articleTitle: Conversion Gain Enhancement of a UTC-PD-Integrated HEMT Photonic Double-Mixer by High-Intensity Optical Subcarrier Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the effect of high-intensity subcarrier signal input to the UTC-PD-integrated HEMT working for optical-to-wireless carrier frequency down-conversion on enhancement of its double-mixing conversion gain. The fabricated UTC-PD-integrated HEMT demonstrated the linear increase in the conversion gain by up to +7 dB with increasing the subcarrier signal intensity without saturation, and the conversion gain enhancement of +6.8 dB from -51.0 dB to -44.2 dB was achieved.

articleTitle: A simple 25 and 12.5 Gb/s dual-rate burst-mode receiver compliant with ITU-T G.9804.3 N1-class
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Our simple dual-rate burst-mode receiver in a TO-46 package is compliant with the 50G-PON N1-class specifications. Receiver sensitivities of -26.5 dBm and -27.8 dBm were achieved for 25 and 12.5 Gb/s signals with 200 ns preamble length.

articleTitle: Geophysical Applications of φ-OTDR/DAS
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: φ-OTDR/DAS enables dense, long-range (1 - 200 km), array recordings of strain fields with exceptional sensitivity (< 1×10<sup>−9</sup> strain) wherever optical fiber exists. The measurement is conventionally based on interferometrically extracting dynamic phase information of the Rayleigh backscattered light from one end of a single-mode fiber. Recently, φ-OTDR/DAS has expanded into telecommunications networking, seismology and geophysics, water infrastructure monitoring, and civil engineering.

articleTitle: Photonic-based W-band Flexible TFDM Integrated Sensing and Communication System for Fiber-wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated a novel W-band photonic-based integration of sensing and communication system for the fiber-wireless integrated network with flexible waveforms and TFDM resource allocation capability, achieving adaptive sensing resolution and communication data-rates.

articleTitle: End-to-End Inter-domain Transport Network Slice Management Using DLT-enabled Cloud-based SDN Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discusses the advantages and challenges of multiple architectures that consider the negotiation of inter-domain transport network slices using blockchain technologies. To this end, we presents results obtained using cloud-native ETSI TeraFlowSDN controller.

articleTitle: Nonlinear-penalty-free Real-time 40×800Gb/s DP-64QAM-PCS Transmission with Launch Power of 28 dBm over a Conjoined-tube Hollow-core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Real-time 40×800Gb/s DP-64QAM-PCS transmissions over three different optical fibers (i.e., CTF, G.652.D, G.654.E) are tested under 28-dBm launch power for the first time. No nonlinear penalty is observed in the CTF link.

articleTitle: First Field Trial of FTTR Based on Native Management and Control Architecture for 5G Small Cell Backhaul
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We firstly propose a native management and control architecture of FTTR, based on which a field trial for 5G small cell backhaul is demonstrated. The download speed of each user equipment reaches nearly 800 Mbps.

articleTitle: Automatic In-situ Optical Linearization of Silicon Photonic Ring-Assisted MZ Modulator for Integrated RF Photonic SoCs
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate automatic optical linearization of a Ring-Assisted MZ modulator with SFDR > 110dB.Hz<sup>2/3</sup>, fabricated in a silicon photonic foundry process. The linearization algorithm reconfigures the modulator to its optimum SFDR or other desired regimes regardless of random phase offsets and process/temperature variations. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of Beyond 100G Three-Dimensional Flexible Coherent PON in Downstream with Time, Frequency and Power Resource Allocation Capability
publicationTitle: 2023 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel three-dimensional flexible coherent PON with the resource-allocation capability in time, frequency and power domain. High flexibility is demonstrated with >100G over 20-km fiber for coherent PON in downstream.
